business_meaning: Primary tracking reference across all logistics systems
notes: Primary key - never null; format SHP-YYYYMMDD-NNNNN

description: UTC timestamp of barcode scan event
business_meaning: Exact moment shipment moved through a checkpoint
related_kpi: On-time delivery rate; Dwell time analysis
notes: UTC timezone - never null; used for SLA calculations

description: Facility or waypoint where scan occurred
business_meaning: Physical checkpoint (warehouse hub port or transit point)
notes: Encoded as CITY-TYPE-SEQ; WH=Warehouse TR=Transit PRT=Port

business_meaning: Planned logistics path from origin to destination
related_kpi: Route delay rate; Cascading delay propagation
notes: Routes may share legs; see route_segments table for sub-paths

description: Difference between scheduled and actual scan time in minutes
business_meaning: Operational lateness at a given checkpoint
related_kpi: Delay frequency; Mean delay per route
notes: Positive = late; Zero = on-time; Negative = early; null if scan missing

description: Categorical code for why a delay occurred
business_meaning: Root cause classification for operational intervention
notes: Codes: WTH=Weather OPS=Operational capacity CUS=Customs VHL=Vehicle breakdown; null if no delay

description: Identifier of warehouse handling the shipment
business_meaning: Which facility currently holds or processed the shipment
related_kpi: Warehouse dwell time; Facility congestion index
notes: Foreign key to warehouses table; null if shipment in transit

description: UTC timestamp when shipment transferred between warehouses
business_meaning: When custody or physical location changed between facilities
related_kpi: Inter-facility transfer rate; Warehouse handoff SLA
notes: null if no transfer occurred on this leg; critical for cascading delay detection

business_meaning: Source location for route analysis and demand mapping
related_kpi: Origin-destination pair volume; Revenue by lane
notes: ISO city name; standardized from CRM address field

description: City where shipment must be delivered
business_meaning: Target delivery location used for SLA assignment
related_kpi: Delivery SLA compliance; Last-mile failure rate
notes: ISO city name; drives SLA tier assignment

description: Identifier of the transport carrier used
business_meaning: Which logistics partner or internal fleet moved the shipment
related_kpi: Carrier on-time rate; Carrier delay contribution
notes: Foreign key to carriers table; used for vendor scorecards

description: Weight of the shipment in kilograms
business_meaning: Physical size proxy affecting vehicle capacity and cost
related_kpi: Load factor per vehicle; Cost per kg
notes: Measured at origin scan; null if not captured; affects pricing

description: Binary indicator - 1 if delay propagated to downstream checkpoints
business_meaning: Whether this shipment caused missed SLAs at subsequent route legs
related_kpi: Cascading delay rate per route; Route risk score
notes: Target variable for delay prediction model; 0=no cascade 1=cascade; never null after profiling

business_meaning: Business segment determining SLA priority and pricing tier
related_kpi: Segment on-time rate; Segment revenue contribution
notes: Values: B2B B2C SMB ENTERPRISE; Updated monthly from CRM

description: Transaction value in USD for the shipment
related_kpi: Monthly revenue; Revenue per route; Customer lifetime value
notes: Strip currency symbols before use; null for internal transfers
